revenue_growth.source: Assumption: fades from 7% toward ~4.5%; FY2026 growth was 15.1% (478,834 vs 416,161) but is not sustainable, FY2025 was 6.4%, so growth converges toward mid-single digits as the base grows.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2026 EBIT margin 33.0% (158,063/478,834), up from 32.0% in FY2025 and 31.5% in FY2024; held flat at the latest level, no further expansion.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approximate Apple effective rate. Not computed from tool output (pretax and net income were reported, so the FY2026 implied rate is 1-132,175/159,237 = 17.0%).

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2024-26 capex/revenue was 2.4%, 3.1% and 1.9%; the 3-year average is about 2.5%.

wacc.source: CAPM: risk-free 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y par yield, 2026-11-06) + assumed levered beta 1.1 (my assumption, not retrieved from a tool) x US ERP 4.46% (Damodaran, 2026-02-16) = 9.8% cost of equity. Debt is about 80B against a much larger market cap, so equity weight is above 95%. Blended WACC is about 9.5%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and near long-run nominal US GDP growth; it also sits below the final-year growth of 4.5%.

net_debt.source: deskstack financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 80,111 (LT debt non-current 68,208 + current 9,906 + commercial paper 1,997) - cash 36,305 - marketable securities 20,417; accession 0000320193-26-000026

diluted_shares.source: Weighted average diluted shares 14,720,306,000 (us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSharesOutstanding), accession 0000320193-26-000026, in millions
